title: Quarkus project using hibernate validator on classes from separate jars does not compile with 1.13.5.Final
body:
## Describe the bug
(Describe the problem clearly and concisely.)
I have a couple of projects that use DTO classes from another jar that are annotated with hibernate validator classes. This includes validations on type declarations for container classes. When I moved from 1.13.4.Final to 1.13.5.final, my project failed to compile.

### Expected behavior
(Describe the expected behavior clearly and concisely.)
I expected everything to compile as with past Quarkus version upgrades.

### Actual behavior
(Describe the actual behavior clearly and concisely.)
The compile for both project failed with stack trace:
F
[demo1.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/6550261/demo1.zip)
ailed to execute goal io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:1.13.5.Final:build (default) on project scoreapi: Failed to build quarkus application: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
[ERROR] [error]: Build step io.quarkus.hibernate.validator.deployment.HibernateValidatorProcessor#build threw an exception: java.lang.ClassCastException: class org.jboss.jandex.ClassInfo cannot be cast to class org.jboss.jandex.MethodInfo (org.jboss.jandex.ClassInfo and org.jboss.jandex.MethodInfo are in unnamed module of loader io.quarkus.bootstrap.classloading.QuarkusClassLoader @5411fed2)
